packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into a single PR per ecosystem
Auto-merge patch-level updates once CI is green
Keep all Symfony packages in lock-step
Major updates require explicit approval via the dependency dashboard
Hold Symfony at 8.0 until the object-mapper 8.1 migration is done (patches still flow)
Do not propose raising the PHP platform requirement
Keep vite and its React plugin upgraded together (plugin-react majors require a matching vite major)

Hold vite + plugin-react majors until vitest ships rolldown-vite-compatible types (vite 8 is rolldown-based and breaks vitest's duplicated-vite type check; plugin-react 6 imports vite/internal and needs vite 8)

No full composer.lock refresh while symfony is held at 8.0 — Renovate runs composer with --no-plugins, so the Symfony Flex pin (extra.symfony.require) is bypassed and transitive components float to 8.1. Re-enable after the 8.1/object-mapper migration.
